s1_family: The hospital needs a blood donor. Please, hurry.
s1_anyone: Does anyone know a blood donor?
n1: DooGo connects people who need blood with voluntary donors who are ready to help.
n2: Donors can view blood requests, and respond when they are available to help.
n3: Donors can update their availability whenever they can, or turn it off when they're unavailable.
s7_thanks: Thank you so much. You really helped us.
s7_course: Of course. I'm glad I could help.
n4: When someone needs blood, finding the right donor shouldn't have to be a struggle.
